ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:
SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all the Commercial Planned Development No. 1185 symbols and identification as
shown on Map No 28-E in the area bounded by:

East 115" Street; South Michigan Avenue; the north right-of-way of the Union Pacific

Railroad; South State Street; a line 168.45 feet south of and parallel to East 115" Street; a

line 246.48 feet east of and parallel to South State Street,
to those of a B3-1 Community Shopping District.
SECTION 2, This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due publication.

Common Address of Property: 11500-11568 S. Michigan Avenue

Anthony A. Beale
